question: Who will receive the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement award at the 2025 Venice Film Festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Werner Herzog**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Filmmaker Werner Herzog will be honored with the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the Venice Film Festival.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Herzog is known for films like “Fitzcarraldo” and "Nosferatu the Vampyre."**
 
• The 82-year-old director will be recognized for his significant contributions to cinema.
 
• Herzog expressed feeling deeply honored to receive the prestigious award.
 
• The Golden Lion is awarded to individuals with exceptional achievements in cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Venice Film Festival__

 
 
• Established: 1932
 
• Location: Venice, Italy
 
• It is the world's oldest film festival & one of the "Big Five" International film festivals worldwide.
